## Tier ladder

See `docs/engineering-standards.md`. Each tier's evidence is checked mechanically by `engine_doctor.py check`:

- **prototype** — compiles and runs; no test obligation
- **working** — ≥1 test listed in `tests:` and those tests exist
- **hardened** — working + fuzz/soak coverage if it parses external input + doc not stale
- **production** — hardened + exercised on every CI platform + a perf claim backed by a test
